tests: decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active ACP repair consumes a receipt-bound compile failure and rejects the candidate
command: DECOMP_REQUIRE_LIVE_ACP_CONTRACT=1 ./gradlew --offline test --console=plain -x verifyFrontendToolchain -x frontendInstall -x frontendBuild --tests 'decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active ACP repair consumes a receipt-bound compile failure and rejects the candidate'

scope.claim: The active repair loop consumes a typed CompileFailed validator result after one scripted ACP candidate mutation. The returned iteration is rejected; the accepted source and graph head remain unchanged; the graph has no pending attempt and retains a COMPILE_FAILED validation observation bound to the candidate invocation, proof, and retained validation artifact.
limitations: The validator is an injected fixture that returns a typed unsuccessful result; this does not qualify a real compiler execution or successful production validation under #236.
Local focused test only; no live provider, hosted exact-head CI, other profile, or complete #734/#63 qualification.
